title: Jurisdictions of Power Deck
subtitle: A 52-card map of sovereignty hubs, legal seats, money jurisdictions, offshore centres, corporate-law venues, free zones, treaty hubs and regulatory gateways.
boundary: This is a jurisdictional research deck. Inclusion maps legal, financial, diplomatic, administrative, tax, corporate, maritime, treaty or regulatory functions. It is not proof of secret control, wrongdoing, unlawful conduct, corruption or conspiracy.
note: Baseline data file. The build-jurisdictions-of-power-deck script regenerates the full 52-card data, card wall, assets and dossier pages.
